Perform a whole-core assumption and comparator audit. Retag joint Gaussianity as novel/restrictive: it is imposed so second moments determine the maintained law and zero covariance has the required independence interpretation; it defines a covariance-based subclass and excludes broader non-Gaussian LiMVAM. Retag Γ_j≻0 as novel regularity: it places each stacked coordinate disturbance in the covariance-cone interior and supports inversion/completion certificates; singular shared-noise limits are outside the theorem. Retag calibration plus marginal sampling as a novel sampling design: an aligned calibration sample for S plus additional viewwise samples from the same target population; require only sourcewise i.i.d. sampling, do not claim cross-estimator independence unless disjoint cohorts are used, and exclude selection/transport. Use the concrete mechanism ε_i^(a)=λ_ia U_i+η_i^(a), with mutually independent coordinate shocks U_i, mutually independent sensor noises η_i^(a) independent of all U_i, centered Gaussian terms, and Var(η_i^(a))>0. State Γ_i=Var(U_i)λ_iλ_i^T+diag_a Var(η_i^(a))≻0 and that coordinate stacks are independent. Present it only for coordinate-aligned repeated measurements/sensors with coordinate-specific shared shocks and independent readout noise, not arbitrary multimodal/neuroimaging data. Define d_π=max over a≠b∈S,i≠j of |R_π^(ab)[i,j]|/sqrt(R_π^(aa)[i,i]R_π^(bb)[j,j]) and d_*=min_π d_π. Population d_*>0 falsifies the class on observed blocks; in samples reject only when a simultaneous lower confidence bound is positive. Non-rejection is not validation and says nothing about unobserved pairs. For τ≥0 report Π_S^(τ)={π:d_π≤τ} and Θ_S^(τ)={T_π:π∈Π_S^(τ)} as a sensitivity envelope, not an unrestricted-class identified set or new theorem. τ=0 is the maintained theorem. Say the application is conditional on this mechanism, common-target sampling, and the diagnostic; Cam-CAN MEG/fMRI is a future diagnostic use case, not a validated application. Add Ghassami et al. (2018) and distinguish its domain-wise heterogeneity/shared-structure mechanism from selected paired covariance blocks and a possibly non-singleton compatibility set.

Make generic two-view sufficiency the v5 headline. Demote the current compatibility iff to Lemma 1 (fixed-order residual characterization) and the hitting-set iff to a computational corollary; remove claims that either definitional unfolding is principal novelty. Add headline theorem: Fix p≥2, m≥3, true common order π0, and distinct views a,b. On the open parameter space of component-aligned Gaussian models where every B^(c) respects π0 and every coordinate Γ_i is positive definite, with no edge-minimality or Heurtebise diversity assumption, clear the positive principal-minor denominators from entries of offdiag R_π^(ab)(θ) for each π≠π0. Let F_π^(ab) be the sum of squares of the polynomial numerators and E_(ab,π0)={θ: product over π≠π0 of F_π^(ab)(θ)=0}. Prove every F_π^(ab) is nonzero, so E is proper algebraic; outside E, Π_{a,b}={π0} and Θ_{a,b}=Θ_M={T_π0}. Thus any preassigned pair is generically sufficient and |S_min|=2 under the maintained |S|≥2 convention; E has Lebesgue measure zero and is avoided almost surely under absolutely continuous parameter laws. Proof route: residual entries are rational with positive principal-minor denominators. For each wrong π choose an inversion u≺π0 v but v≺π u. Construct a witness with only edge u→v active in views a,b, coefficient β≠0, unit within-view disturbance variances, cross-view correlations r_u≠r_v, positive-definite Γ_u,Γ_v, all other coordinates independent. The wrong-order residual has embedded term β(r_u-r_v)/(1+β²), up to orientation, hence F_π is not identically zero. Finitely many wrong orders make the product nonzero; π0 passes by component alignment. Add non-headline corollary: outside E the pairwise wrong-order feasibility margin is positive by finiteness, so existing covariance-region inversion specializes to singleton recovery under its existing sampling/path-separation assumptions. Use equality examples as points on E. Keep output-sensitive quotienting as OEQ. Do not claim hardness, quotient enumeration, or arbitrary calibration-graph completion.
